close_reason: Epic complete. 15 of 16 children closed; the remaining one (JMAP-zx3s.17) is labeled 'deferred' as a forward-major-version follow-up for the typed ParentIdFilter enum and stays open as parked backlog. Final gate: cargo fmt clean, cargo test --workspace --all-features green, cargo clippy --workspace --all-features -D warnings clean.
description:
Pre-merge deep review of crate-jmap-mail-types since base commit 9c0d34f. Diff is 14 files changed (+1130/-35), dominated by the extras-preservation policy rollout (bd JMAP-lbdy.2). Scope: every public Deserialize struct that appears on the JMAP wire received a flatten/Map<String,Value> extra field, with a round-trip test asserting unknown vendor fields survive deserialize/serialize. Filter-algebra and capability types were correctly excluded per workspace policy. PLAN.md, README.md, and AGENTS.md were updated to document the new policy and the canonical-template propagation rule.

Findings filed under this epic cover: (1) a stale doc reference to a non-existent EmailSubmissionState type; (2) a workspace-wide naming divergence between the policy's Unknown(String) example and the actual code's Other(String) variant naming; (3) minor canonical-template derive inconsistencies (MailboxFilterCondition missing PartialEq/Eq vs sibling filter conditions); (4) forward-looking type-design flags on Email::new positional args and MdnSendRequest.send typed-key discipline; (5) a test-coverage gap on the extras-preservation tests; (6) pre-existing missing constructors on the four Mdn*Request/Response types that the migration aggravates slightly. No P0 correctness bugs.
title: Review: crate-jmap-mail-types since 9c0d34f
